retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome urban scene featuring a solitary figure leaning against a brick wall in a dark alleyway with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition dominated by deep shadows and harsh highlights, depicting a man in casual attire leaning against a brick pillar next to a concrete staircase. A single bright light source from a doorway creates long shadows and sharp textures on the brickwork.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure centered against a vertical brick pillar
Diagonal lines of the staircase leading from bottom right to center
High contrast between the bright doorway on the left and deep shadows on the right
Text block anchored in the top left corner with a distinct color accent
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range
Visible brick texture throughout the background
Dramatic side-lighting creating a silhouette effect on one side of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned centrally, leaning against a vertical architectural element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing doorway in the mid-ground left acts as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left text block, moves down to the bright doorway, follows the figure's lean, and descends the diagonal stairs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of deep black negative space in the shadows of the alley and under the stairs.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and light grey highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purple/magenta used exclusively for typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated monochrome image with a single high-saturation color block for text.
paletteRestrictions: Single accent color for graphic elements

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed display paired with wide-tracked light subtitle within a framed box.
graphicDevices: Rectangular frame with a thin border
Horizontal divider line between text tiers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, heavy-weight display style.
Matches the expanded, clean sans-serif subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in a white shirt and jeans leaning against a brick pillar in a dark alley. Include a bright light source from a doorway on the left and a concrete staircase on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular box in the top-left corner with a thin white border. Inside, place bold purple condensed sans-serif text on top and wide-tracked grey sans-serif text below it, separated by a thin line.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochrome except for the text box?
Is the lighting dramatic with deep shadows?
Is the text box positioned in the top-left corner?
Does the brick texture appear sharp and detailed?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
Ensure the text content is generic or user-specified
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the top-left boxed text
Ensure the brick wall and stairs create strong diagonal and vertical lines
Confirm the single accent color is applied only to the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Noir + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Brick Texture + Boxed Sans-Serif Typography
